card.name: Just before a population group is named
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a short word that closes a risk statement, right where a patient group such as children, adolescents or adults is likely to come next. Seen mostly after "(suicidality" in antidepressant warnings.

modes.label: Closing bracket after suicidality
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after "suicidality" in the antidepressant warning, just before "in children, adolescents, and young adults".
modes.example: Antidepressants increased the risk compared to placebo of suicidal thinking and behavior (suicidality<<)>> in children, adolescents, and young adults

modes.label: Linking word in a risk statement
modes.description: A short linking word or noun in a warning sentence, where a group or time phrase tends to follow.
modes.example: Angina may worsen or appear<< for>> the first time during minoxidil treatment

card.writes: It lowers the odds of population words such as adults, adolescents, children and individuals as the next word.
card.plain: It fires at the spot in a warning where a patient group like children or adults would usually be named next.
